panels.title: Running jobs

targets.expr: sum by (job) (time() - rustic_job_start_timestamp_seconds and on (job) ((rustic_job_running == 1) and on (unit) label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{state="activating"} == 1, "unit", "$1", "name", "(.+)")))
sum by (job) (rustic_job_progress_ratio and on (job) ((rustic_job_running == 1) and on (unit) label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{state="activating"} == 1, "unit", "$1", "name", "(.+)")))
sum by (job) (rustic_job_progress_bytes_done and on (job) ((rustic_job_running == 1) and on (unit) label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{state="activating"} == 1, "unit", "$1", "name", "(.+)")))
sum by (job) (rustic_job_progress_bytes_total and on (job) ((rustic_job_running == 1) and on (unit) label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{state="activating"} == 1, "unit", "$1", "name", "(.+)")))
sum by (job) (rustic_job_progress_eta_seconds and on (job) ((rustic_job_running == 1) and on (unit) label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{state="activating"} == 1, "unit", "$1", "name", "(.+)")))

sum by (job) (rate(rustic_job_ip_egress_bytes[5m]) and on (job) ((rustic_job_running == 1) and on (unit) label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{state="activating"} == 1, "unit", "$1", "name", "(.+)")))

panels.description: Progress covers the current byte-counting phase. A backup counts source bytes read, a copy counts packed bytes copied, once for data packs and again for tree packs. Upload needs IPAccounting on the unit, which rustic-copy and rustic-jotta have.

panels.title: Upload now
panels.description: WAN upload from the router's SNMP counters, against the egress of the backup units.

panels.title: Jobs

targets.expr: sum by (job, result) (label_replace((rustic_job_running == 1) and on (unit) label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{state="activating"} == 1, "unit", "$1", "name", "(.+)"), "result", "running", "", "")) or sum by (job, result) (label_replace((rustic_job_running == 1) unless on (job) ((rustic_job_running == 1) and on (unit) label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{state="activating"} == 1, "unit", "$1", "name", "(.+)")), "result", "interrupted", "", "")) or sum by (job, result) (rustic_job_result unless on (job) (rustic_job_running == 1))
max by (job) (rustic_timer_next_elapse_timestamp_seconds * on (unit) group_left (job) (max by (unit, job) (rustic_job_start_timestamp_seconds) * 0 + 1)) * 1000

panels.description: Result, end, duration and added to repo are for the last finished run. Start, warnings, errors and retries are for the current run while one is running. Interrupted means stopped by SIGTERM, as at the nightly update reboot, or left marked running by a power loss. Next run is blank while a job runs and until the hourly inventory after it ends.

panels.title: Latest snapshot age
panels.description: Per host and path. Orange after 26 h, a daily period plus the run time. Red after 2 days, when a daily healthchecks check with 1 day of grace has alerted. Copy lag is how much older the newest jotta snapshot is than the newest NAS one. The NAS repo is listed hourly, jotta after each job that writes to it.

panels.title: Inventory age
panels.description: Time since rustic-inventory last listed each repo's snapshots.

panels.title: Upload rate
panels.description: Egress of each backup unit, measured by systemd IP accounting, against the router's WAN upload.

panels.title: Mac to NAS
panels.description: Bytes received by rustic-serve per hour. Sampled hourly by rustic-inventory.

panels.title: Upload retries
panels.description: Backend requests rustic retried in the current or last run, such as jotta 409s.

panels.title: Added to repo per run
panels.description: Packed bytes the last backup run added. Copies and maintenance report none.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Peaks are systemd's MemoryPeak and MemorySwapPeak for the job's unit, which include page cache. They rise during a run and hold after it.

panels.title: Space
panels.description: For a ZFS dataset, size minus available is the space it uses.

panels.title: Snapshots
panels.description: Every snapshot in the repo, including jotta's old sentinel groups that the coverage table hides.

panels.title: Maintenance

targets.expr: sum by (job, result) (label_replace((rustic_job_running{job=~"nas-maintain-.+"} == 1) and on (unit) label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{state="activating"} == 1, "unit", "$1", "name", "(.+)"), "result", "running", "", "")) or sum by (job, result) (label_replace((rustic_job_running{job=~"nas-maintain-.+"} == 1) unless on (job) ((rustic_job_running{job=~"nas-maintain-.+"} == 1) and on (unit) label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{state="activating"} == 1, "unit", "$1", "name", "(.+)")), "result", "interrupted", "", "")) or sum by (job, result) (rustic_job_result{job=~"nas-maintain-.+"} unless on (job) (rustic_job_running{job=~"nas-maintain-.+"} == 1))

label_replace(count(max by (job) (rustic_job_start_timestamp_seconds{job=~"nas-ssd-data|nas-copy"}) > max by (job) (rustic_job_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job=~"nas-ssd-data|nas-copy"})) or vector(0), "job", "nas-maintain-nas", "", "") or label_replace(count(max by (job) (rustic_job_start_timestamp_seconds{job=~"nas-tank-data|nas-copy"}) > max by (job) (rustic_job_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job=~"nas-tank-data|nas-copy"})) or vector(0), "job", "nas-maintain-jotta", "", "")

panels.description: Each repo is maintained in the off-peak window once rustic-due allows it: 6 days after the last NAS success, 27 after the last jotta one. Outstanding jobs counts the jobs rustic-idle waits for, ones with a start newer than their last success: nas-ssd-data and nas-copy for the NAS repo, nas-tank-data and nas-copy for jotta.
